{{Top|leg}}
'''I2-1A''' was a [[Science droid/Legends|science droid]] owned by [[Nestin Thokor]], the [[Comptroller]] of the city of [[Oluna Biqua]], on [[Genarius]]. When the city's population were infected with the gas [[Trinex-M]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] obtained a sample of it and I2 developed a cure for the gas with it.
